title: Node accepts noncanonical peer IID and targets the wrong EUI-64
description: Correctness review finding (P3) in the final SIID/Extended-destination path: PeerIdentity.__post_init__ validates only lengths, so callers can construct PeerIdentity(pubkey=valid_key, iid=arbitrary_8_bytes). Node.add_peer stores that unverified IID verbatim at python/src/lichen/node.py:301-308, _peer_for_next_hop indexes link-local routes by IID at lines 320-329, and _transmit_peer_schc converts peer.iid into the exact Extended wire EUI-64 at lines 610-615/622-625. The public out-of-band add_peer path can therefore make a canonical route unresolvable or transmit an authenticated SCHC packet to an EUI-64 unrelated to the peer pubkey/policy. Canonicalize an exact PeerIdentity.from_pubkey(peer.pubkey) (or reject any IID mismatch) on add and when accepting constructor-supplied peer_db state; add a regression covering link-local lookup and Extended targeting.
